newsitem.title: INDONESIA: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - Dec 23.
newsitem.headline: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - Dec 23.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Indonesian stocks on Monday:
* The Dow Jones industrial average rose 10.76 points to 6,484.40 last Friday after swinging wildly amid the so-called triple-witching expirations of December futures and options.
* President Suharto said on Sunday big businesses which failed to give two percent of their after-tax incomes to the poor would be "morally chastised," the Jakarta Post reported.

* Retailer Multipolar Corp, controlled by the Lippo Group, announced its purchase of a 45-percent stake in one of Indonesia's largest retailers Matahari Putra Prima, and plans to acquire another 5.1 percent.
* The composite index rose 4.21 points, or 0.67 percent, to 632.52 points last Friday but was off highs on profit-taking
* On Monday, the rupiah was quoted at 2,363.10/63.50 in early trading against the opening of 2,361.00/62.00.
* Multipolar on announcement it had purchased a 45-percent stake in Matahari and plans to buy another 5.1 percent.
* Footwear manufacturer Telagamas Pertiwi on announcement it planned to buy a 100 percent stake worth 40.5 billion rupiah in distribution firm Artha Graha Wahana.
* Plastic packaging manufacturer Arga Karya on a plan to halve its nominal share price to 500 rupiah from 1,000 rupiah.
* Ometraco Corporation on reports that the conglomerate planned to set up a joint venture insurance firm with General Accident of the United Kingdom.
